ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85:15 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) to high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white contiguous clusters are located at the distal tips of both left and right lobes. A prominent mid-intensity grey irregular geometric patch is mapped to the lower-central region of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with an approximate 45-degree interior angle and a bounding-box depth approximately 15% of the total visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations consisting of sharp peaks and shallow valleys distributed along the entire upper boundary; serration amplitude increases significantly at the lateral distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curves fitted to the outer lateral boundaries of both lobes, tapering inward toward the water line insertion point.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of a cluster of roughly circular, mid-intensity pixel regions (diameter approx. 10-20 pixels) located on the lower-medial quadrant of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (grey-on-black) oriented diagonally on the medial-right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large, irregular mid-intensity grey depigmentation patch on the left lobe, showing jagged boundaries against the primary low-intensity background.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct asymmetry in the white pigmentation pattern at the tips; the right tip exhibits a vertical, comb-like high-intensity pattern whereas the left tip shows a more horizontal, solid distribution.
